The reverse DCF confirms it: the neutral structure implies a **−17.1% 10-year CAGR** in owner cash flow — below the p50 base rate (8.9%) for this size bucket, i.e. the market prices in *decay of the business itself*, not merely rate normalization.

- **ACTIVE SHOCK `oil_shock` (onset 2026-09-28, severity 1, up):** the unresolved Strait of Hormuz closure (Iran/US standoff; Trump rejected a 7-day reopening proposal on 2026-09-26) has re-routed ~30% of global seaborne LPG away from the Gulf. This is the *central swing factor* for GASS: it is simultaneously the Bull engine (record rates, US export boom) and the Bear trigger (reopening = rate normalization). [Actual shock state; route mechanics per Veson/Clarksons via IndexBox, 2026-05-12 — Estimate]
- **China slowdown:** retail sales +0.4% y/y, urban FAI −7.2% Jan–Aug 2026 (CNBC feed, 2026-09-24) — weak Asian LPG demand is a real headwind for the ~21% of GASS fleet days still on spot. [Estimate]
- **Fiscal stress:** global debt $365T, rising government yields (2026-09-24 feed) — risk-off backdrop; micro-cap liquidity risk for GASS specifically. [Estimate]

## SECTION 2 — BUSINESS & MOAT

**Economic engines (Pillar 1 decomposition):**

1. **Transactional (spot) deliveries — ~21% of fleet days.** Q2 2026: 515 spot days of 2,402 fleet days; average daily TCE $15,709 [Actual, PRIMARY P1]. Purely cyclical; this is where Hormuz upside and normalization downside live.
2. **Contracted period-charter annuity — ~79% of fleet days.** This is the real asset, and it is *filed*: "About 60% of fleet days for the remainder of 2026 are secured on period charters, with total fleet employment days for all periods generating about $90 million (excl. our single JV vessel) in contracted revenues" (PRIMARY P1, 2026-09-03). New 2-year T/C on *Gas Flawless* to Jul 2028, 1-year on *Eco Dominator* to Sep 2027, extensions to Mar/Feb 2027 (P1); ~$30M secured for 2027 per the Sept call [Unconfirmed — call transcript not in pack]. This is a genuine multi-quarter revenue floor, not prepayment float.
3. **Strategic optionality (balance sheet):** "over $250 million currently" liquidity after the ~$77M Eco Wizard insurance settlement; zero bank debt since Q3 2025; all vessels unencumbered (PRIMARY P1). Options: resumed buybacks ("paused only due to price appreciation" — Sept call, Unconfirmed), opportunistic sales into the market top (two vessels sold H1 2026 for $3.9M net gain [Actual P1]), or counter-cyclical fleet consolidation if rates collapse.

**Owner earnings after SBC:** FY2025 OCF $85M − filed SBC $5M = **$80M** [Actual, constructed from DATA 5; the pack's owner-earnings default is unavailable — no TTM for this 20-F filer]. H1 2026 cross-check: NI $33.2M + D&A $11.6M − SBC $2.6M ≈ $42.2M (≈$84M run-rate) [Actual, P1] — consistent. Q2 2026 net margin ~40% ($17.3M on $42.9M).

**Moat (7 factors, 0–3 each):** cost advantage 1 (standardized tonnage; related-party management fees to Maran) · switching costs 1 (charterers switch freely; period charters give stickiness, not lock-in) · network effects 0 · intangibles/brand 1 (recognized LPG owner, unencumbered fleet) · scale 1 (26 vessels vs Dorian/BW fleets) · asset quality & positioning 2 (younger Panamax fleet, zero debt — a real differentiator in a levered peer group) · regulatory barriers 1 (IMO rules raise entry cost for older tonnage; newbuilds ~$115–120M keep the door open). **Total 7/21 → 2.3/5, direction IMPROVING** (deleveraging complete, fleet refreshed, older tonnage sold into the top). This is a *disciplined commodity business*, not a moat compounder — the valuation must reflect that, and it does (terminal_ronic held at the COE anchor, no premium).

**Financial strength:** FY2025 equity $690M vs total liabilities $21M [Actual, DATA 6B]; cash + ST investments $168.3M at 2026-06-30, >$250M currently [Actual P1]; ~$350M of bank debt repaid over three years (Sept call — Unconfirmed detail). Piotroski 7/8 evaluable; accruals −0.034 (cash-backed earnings) [Arithmetic, DATA 7].

**Frame & structure:** equity frame (all pack flows are after-interest; net debt is negative).
